evidence.title: Housing Act 2004
evidence.content: The Housing Act 2004 reformed housing standards and introduced selective licensing in England. It requires landlords to meet minimum standards for rental properties.

evidence.title: Planning and Infrastructure Act 2024
evidence.content: Recent legislation aimed at speeding up housebuilding and delivering more homes. Includes changes to planning permissions and infrastructure requirements.

evidence.title: Homelessness Reduction Act 2017
evidence.content: Legislation that extended protection for homeless people and placed new duties on local authorities to help those at risk of homelessness.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Debate: Housing Crisis
evidence.content: Members of Parliament discussed the ongoing housing shortage and affordability crisis. Debate covered solutions including building new homes, reforming planning rules, and supporting first-time buyers.

evidence.title: Committee Report: Future of Housing Policy
evidence.content: A select committee published findings on housing policy effectiveness, examining planning reforms, developer contributions, and housing delivery targets across the UK.

evidence.title: Renters Reform Bill 2024
evidence.content: Proposed legislation to reform the private rental sector, including abolishing no-fault evictions and strengthening tenant protections.

evidence.title: Levelling Up Act 2023
evidence.content: Legislation focused on regional development and housing as part of the levelling up agenda. Includes provisions for local authority housing and regeneration projects.

evidence.title: Office for Budget Responsibility: Housing Forecasts
evidence.content: Analysis of housing market trends, including house price forecasts, housing supply projections, and economic impacts of housing policy changes.

evidence.title: Environment Act 2021
evidence.content: Comprehensive environment legislation establishing legally binding environmental targets, including improvements to air and water quality, biodiversity restoration, and waste reduction measures.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Debate: Climate Change and Environmental Policy
evidence.content: Members discussed the UK's climate commitments, net-zero targets, and environmental regulations. Debate included energy transition, renewable investments, and ecological protection.

evidence.title: Skills and Post-Secondary Education Act 2022
evidence.content: Legislation reforming higher education, vocational training, and apprenticeships. Establishes new frameworks for skills development and employer engagement in education.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Committee: Education and Skills Reform
evidence.content: Select committee report examining the effectiveness of education and skills policy, including funding for schools, teacher retention, and vocational training pathways.

evidence.title: Health and Social Care Act 2023
evidence.content: Major health sector legislation addressing NHS funding, social care reforms, and healthcare worker protections. Includes provisions for mental health services and preventive care.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Debate: NHS and Healthcare System
evidence.content: Debate on NHS funding, waiting times, healthcare workforce challenges, and social care integration. Members discussed policy responses to patient safety and service delivery.

evidence.title: Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Bill 2023
evidence.content: Legislation addressing economic crime, including money laundering prevention, beneficial ownership transparency, and corporate accountability measures.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Debate: Economic Crime and Fraud Prevention
evidence.content: Members discussed strategies to combat economic crime, including corporate fraud, money laundering, and financial exploitation. Debate covered regulatory reform and law enforcement.

evidence.title: Online Safety Bill 2023
evidence.content: Landmark legislation regulating online content, platform accountability, and digital safety. Includes protections for children and standards for content moderation.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Debate: Digital Rights and Online Regulation
evidence.content: Debate on digital safety, online privacy, platform regulation, and protection of children online. Members discussed balancing free speech with safety measures.

evidence.title: Nationality and Borders Act 2022
evidence.content: Immigration and nationality legislation covering asylum procedures, border control, and immigration enforcement. Establishes new frameworks for visa processing.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Debate: Immigration and Border Policy
evidence.content: Members debated immigration policy, asylum reform, border security, and immigration enforcement. Discussion included integration programs and refugee support.

evidence.title: Strikes (Minimum Service Levels) Bill 2023
evidence.content: Legislation establishing minimum service levels during industrial action across key sectors including transport and utilities.

evidence.title: Parliamentary Debate: Workers' Rights and Industrial Action
evidence.content: Debate on strikes, workers' rights, trade union protections, and employment law. Members discussed balancing worker protections with public service continuity.
